caption: A brittle infantry block (blue) facing east is attacked by a larger infantry block, breaks while still in contact and turns at once to flee north, its block turned about 85 degrees off its flight, so its front ranks become its east flank. The pursuers hold that flank back behind the block's centre, and the block is now laid out from its leading men instead of from that flank. On this clip's seed (seed 0; measured 2026-11-11 against main e78d81be) it drifts 0.5 m west in the 2.2 seconds after it breaks, against 1.1 m before this fix, and stands 0.9 m further north at the end of them.
